stemBlocks: Graph 1 shows how the displacement of one of the particles of a medium varies with time in seconds as a wave travels through the medium.
Graph 2 shows how the displacement varies with distance in metres at one time for the same wave.
Which expression gives the speed in m s$^{-1}$ of the wave?

assets.alt: Graph 1 shows displacement vs time, with a period $T = t_2 - t_1$. Graph 2 shows displacement vs distance, with half a wavelength $\lambda/2 = x_2 - x_1$.
